cpu_usage.scope: Aggregate child CPU including PostgreSQL, Redis, API, worker, migrations and client provisioning/load; not instantaneous server utilization.

memory_usage.scope: Largest child-process peak RSS from getrusage; not simultaneous total service memory.

environment: Disposable local PostgreSQL/PostGIS and Redis; single API and worker; not production sizing.
database_query_measurement: One warm radius query over this accumulated disposable dataset, client elapsed including result fetch; not p95.
